Bash To Ash Privacy Policy

Effective date: 14 October 2026

Developer: Rawan Alghamdi

Contact: bashtoash@gmail.com

This policy explains how Bash To Ash on iPhone and iPad handles information. You can read it offline in Settings > Support & privacy > Privacy Policy. Online services, privacy requests and provider websites need an internet connection. The online data handling below applies when you choose a feature and its service is available.

Your choices

• Play against bots without linking an account, buying anything, watching an ad or sharing optional gameplay analytics. • Control optional analytics in Settings > Share gameplay data. This choice is separate from advertising choices. • Manage advertising choices in Settings > Support & privacy > Ad privacy choices when the provider offers choices for your region. • Edit your public nickname and optional country in Your profile. Choose a nickname that does not reveal information you want to keep private. • Link an account and use Cloud backup if you want to recover supported progress on another device. • Start deletion of a guest or linked game account in Settings > Account > Delete game account.

The game does not access your camera, photos, address book, microphone or precise location. You can choose a public nickname; a default or generated name is used when you have not chosen one. Your optional profile country is selected manually, not read from GPS or device location. There is no free-form chat or upload of your own images.

Information on your device

The game stores settings, your public profile, Device coins, cosmetic choices, saved looks, favorites, achievements, match records, earned reward cards, pending referral and reward claims, and information needed to resume your account and purchases. Device coins come from completed matches and free reward claims. Their balance and outfits bought with them stay on the device. Your private defender nickname also stays on the device; it is excluded from cloud backups and room messages. This private name is separate from the public nickname in Your profile.

The game also keeps limited local diagnostic logs to help investigate technical problems. The app does not automatically upload these log files. If you contact support, send only information you choose to share.

Deleting the app can remove local progress. It does not delete server records, provider accounts or Apple's purchase history. A device backup may also retain local data under your device's backup settings.

Game accounts and cloud backups

Online features use Unity Gaming Services. A guest sign-in creates a player identifier even if you do not provide an email address. This is an account identifier, not a promise of anonymity. Unity receives connection information such as your IP address, and the app keeps session information to sign you in again.

If you choose Link account, Unity Player Accounts handles sign-in in its account interface. Unity and any sign-in provider you select process the identity details you provide under their own policies. The game uses the resulting linked identity to recover your game account; we do not receive your sign-in password.

Cloud backup stores your public nickname and chosen country, your defender's selected parts and colors, saved looks, favorites, supported cosmetic, achievement and event progress, match records and last selected mode with your player identifier and backup history. You initiate backup from Account. It does not back up Device coins, ownership of outfits bought with them, or locally earned reward-card stock and its claim journal. It is separate from the Account coins wallet and does not upload your private defender nickname, analytics choice, sign-in tokens or payment receipts. Recovery uses the linked account; an unlinked guest identity may be unrecoverable if its device session is lost.

Public profile and rankings

When you use competitive rankings or the public queue, our rankings service processes your player identifier, public nickname and chosen country. It stores your rating, wins, current and best win streak, verified-match count and profile revision, and derives your league from your rating. Other signed-in players can receive your player identifier, public nickname, chosen country, league, rating, verified-match count, profile freshness details and displayed ranking results. Choosing the Friends view filters which public profiles you see; it does not make your own ranking profile private.

Country rankings use the country you choose in Your profile. You may leave it unset; a country is required only for that ranking view. Friends rankings use the accepted friend identifiers supplied by the app. World, country and friends rankings use the same verified public-match records. A new account can have a starting rating without having played a verified match; this is not a verified achievement.

The rankings service stores confirmed match identifiers, mode, public or private match type, completion information, participant identifiers, placements, rating changes and verification timestamps. This supports fair rankings, reward verification and prevention of duplicate results. Only verified public results affect competitive rating, wins and streaks. Private results can support separate records and eligible rewards without changing competitive rankings. Offline cumulative trophy progress is separate from verified competitive results. Separately, completed offline play can submit cumulative trophy progress and a generated name to Unity Leaderboards. This client-reported board is not a verified public-match skill ranking.

Friends, private rooms and public matches

Unity Friends stores friend requests, accepted friendships, blocks, presence and room invitations against player identifiers. Friends can see your public game identity and online status. Once you use Friends, the game reconnects to receive requests and invitations. You can decline requests, remove friends and block players.

Private rooms and the public queue use Unity Lobby and Relay. Room participants exchange public nicknames or generated fallback names, defender appearance, readiness and gameplay state. Unity processes room membership, join codes, connection data and network traffic to run the room. Share a private-room code only with people you want to join. Copy and Share work only when you choose them.

When available, the public queue uses your verified game identity, rating, league and selected mode to find opponents in the same league with no more than a 100-point rating gap across the group. Waiting does not broaden that limit or change leagues. While you search, the public discovery listing can expose queue and mode information, league, the queue's reference rating, and lobby and player identifiers to other searching players. The room information above is exchanged with the matched participants. Leaving or failing to find a match does not create a verified result.

Our game service also checks room membership and who is allowed to host, helping prevent impersonation and protect reconnection after an interruption. It processes game-account and room identifiers, temporary host and connection information, and short-lived, single-use join confirmations. The room host confirms membership using your game-account identifier. Other participants receive a non-secret player reference so the game can recognize a returning seat. Your sign-in credentials are not sent to other players.

Player reports and blocking

When you explicitly submit a player report, our rankings service receives your game-account identifier, the reported player's identifier, your selected reason, the app feature the report came from, the public nickname you observed and a request reference. The service can also record the reported player's current public nickname, receipt, review status and outcome, review reference and submission time. We use this information to review misuse and protect players. A reported observation is not independent proof of a violation. The in-app form does not collect free-form report text or screenshots, and its report content is not sent to optional gameplay analytics.

Player reports and records of review actions expire after 30 days and are removed by routine cleanup while the service is running. Game-account deletion erases reports involving that account as the reporter or reported player. Spam-prevention counters identify only the reporting account and expire after one day; they can remain when a reported account is deleted. Separate request references linked only to the reporting account expire after 30 days to prevent duplicate or repurposed requests. These references contain no reported-player identity or evidence, can remain after a reported account is deleted, and are erased when the reporting account is deleted. Enforcement records, such as account suspensions and references to suppressed names, remain until the restriction is lifted or the account is deleted. The backup limitations in the retention section also apply.

Blocks are stored by Unity Friends against player identifiers. They are also checked to prevent future public matching with blocked players. Blocking does not automatically disconnect an ongoing match. You can contact Support & privacy if a report cannot be submitted or you need further help.

Purchases and rewards

Apple handles payment for coin packs, reward-card packs and the First Flight pass. We do not receive your payment-card details. The game and its purchase service process product and transaction identifiers, purchase status, refund information and an account-binding token to validate purchases and prevent duplicate delivery.

The game service stores Account coins, account reward cards, verified entitlements, ownership of outfits bought with Account coins, and transaction records with your game account. Account coins include server-verified rewarded-ad earnings, eligible reward-card bonuses, gift and referral rewards, and purchased Coins. They are separate from Device coins and cosmetic cloud backups. A guest account can earn Account coins from ads; purchases and account gift, referral and reward-card operations require a linked, recoverable account. Recovering the same linked game account lets the service retrieve its Account coins and verified entitlements; Restore purchases does not grant a spent coin pack again.

The app caches previously verified account entitlements so you can equip supported owned cosmetics offline for up to 24 hours after the last verified refresh. Reconnect to verify and renew that access; this limit does not apply to Device coins or outfits bought with them. Spending Account coins requires a connection. Device coins and Account coins cannot be combined to buy one outfit; the Shop identifies which balance is used.

Rewarded-ad delivery uses an opaque reward-attempt identifier linked to your game account. The game service verifies completion information, credits the displayed Account coins reward once and keeps receipt information to handle delayed delivery and prevent duplicate claims. These records are not sent to optional gameplay analytics as purchase receipts.

Reward-doubler cards are separate from watching rewarded videos. Earned cards and their local match claims are stored on the device. Account cards and their redemption records are stored with your game account; an eligible account-card claim includes a match identifier, mode, public or private match type, placement, verified completion reference and the exact bonus. These records prevent spending a card or crediting the same match twice.

Gift and referral services process your player identifier, coded gift or referral references, eligibility and expiry information, request identifiers, reward amounts and redemption history. A referral also links the referring and invited game accounts and checks their friendship status to establish a new accepted friendship. Opening a share sheet or sending a room invitation does not prove that a referral was accepted. A shared referral identifies the referring game account to the recipient. The app does not upload your address book; sharing takes place only through the copy or share action you choose.

Optional gameplay analytics

Unity Analytics receives gameplay and performance events only after you enable Share gameplay data. Events include session and match duration, game mode, placement, completed matches, earned rewards, use of combat tools, Device-coin cosmetic purchases including outfit identifier, price and remaining balance, menu and room steps, frame-rate bands and error counts. Custom events use fixed game identifiers, numbers, yes/no values and limited engine-reported device and operating-system descriptions, not text you enter, room codes, friend identifiers or your full defender design or look code. Automatic real-money purchase analytics is disabled.

Unity adds technical information such as installation and session identifiers, timestamps, app and device details, language settings and an approximate country derived from the connection's IP address. Standard events can include your Unity player identifier and Apple's identifier for vendor. This is not Apple's advertising identifier. Analytics can therefore be associated with a recoverable game account.

We use this information to understand usage and improve performance and gameplay. Turning sharing off stops optional collection and requests deletion of the installation's previously collected analytics. A request may remain pending while the app or service is offline and retries when it can connect. Disabling analytics does not delete account, purchase, friend or advertising records needed for their separate purposes.

Optional rewarded advertising

Google AdMob supplies optional rewarded ads. You choose an offer on Home and see its exact reward before watching. Ads are not shown during live gameplay. Declining an offer or an advertising privacy choice does not prevent normal play. A reward never depends on clicking an advertisement or accepting tracking permission.

Before requesting ads, the app asks you to select an age band: under 13, 13–17, or 18 and over. No band is selected by default. The app stores this choice locally and applies protective age-restricted advertising settings for anyone under 18 or whose age band has not been selected; it does not collect or send your birth date. Open Settings > Support & privacy > Ad privacy choices to review your age band and the provider's privacy options where available. After an age band is saved, the app refreshes the provider's consent status on later launches without automatically opening a form; required forms wait until you choose an ad or open privacy options. Ad requests use the provider's most restrictive general content rating and non-personalized settings. Selecting an older band or accepting consent gives no extra reward.

Non-personalized ads still involve data collection. Google can process your IP address, approximate location, app- or developer-scoped identifiers, ad views and interactions, and device, crash and performance information to deliver, measure and secure ads. Advertising privacy forms also process your region and consent choices. The app does not request Apple's cross-app tracking permission.

The game supplies an opaque reward-attempt reference for reward verification, not your nickname, email address, room code or payment information. Advertising choices and data handling are separate from optional Unity gameplay analytics.

To report an ad, open the rewarded offer on Home, select REPORT AD and choose a reason. This reports the most recently shown ad. The report sends the selected reason, ad response identifier and reward-attempt reference to our service so we can investigate it. You can also contact support without clicking the ad.

Recipients and purposes

• Unity Technologies provides authentication, Player Accounts, Cloud Save, Leaderboards, Friends, Lobby, Relay and optional Analytics. • Apple processes App Store purchases, payment approval, restoration and refunds. • Google provides AdMob advertising and its privacy-choice interface. Its advertising partners may process ad-delivery information under the choices presented to you. • Our game-service hosting providers process account-linked public profiles, rankings, match verification, wallet, reward cards, gifts, referrals, room security, player reports, moderation, deletion and support records on our behalf. • Other players receive the public profile, ranking, referral and room information described above through Ranks, Friends, private rooms and public matches.

We do not sell your gameplay or account records. Advertising providers process the information described in the advertising section. We may disclose information when necessary to comply with a legal obligation or address fraud or security incidents.

Provider information is available at https://unity.com/legal/game-player-and-app-user-privacy-policy, https://policies.google.com/privacy and https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/data/en/app-store/. Opening these websites is optional and requires a connection.

Retention and account deletion

Local settings and progress remain until replaced, reset or removed with the app. Cloud profiles, public ranking profiles, confirmed match records, social relationships, leaderboard entries, wallet records and gift, referral and reward-card records remain while needed to provide their features, unless removed through the relevant controls or game-account deletion. Service providers can retain their own connection, security and payment records according to their policies and legal duties.

Temporary room-join verification and host records are cleared on expiry through periodic cleanup or through game-account deletion. Limited room history without player-account identifiers can remain to prevent old room connections from being reused.

Settings > Account > Delete game account starts deletion for either a guest or linked game account. Review the confirmation before proceeding: deletion removes access to that account, its cloud profile, public ranking profile, match participation records, social relationships, leaderboard data, wallet, player reports and associated gift, referral and reward-card records. It does not automatically refund purchases. The app shows Pending until the required game-account deletion steps succeed, then Completed. Unity may still be processing the separate analytics deletion request after game-account deletion is complete. Completed does not mean the limited records described below have been erased.

Limited, pseudonymous purchase and ledger records can be retained for applicable financial recordkeeping and purchase disputes, with an expiry under the service's retention policy. Minimal hashed deletion, match and reward-receipt identifiers help prevent a deleted account or old result or reward from being reopened or redeemed again. Rankings deletion and match-replay hashes remain while the game project exists; they do not retain your nickname, country or original player identifier after deletion completes. These records are kept separately from the active game profile and are not used for marketing. Contact us for the retention terms that apply to your request.

Deleting your account does not cancel valid results or rewards already earned by other players. Aggregate gift-redemption counts and records needed to preserve another player's reward can remain without your original account identifier. Server backup copies may remain until their normal replacement; deletion restrictions must be reapplied before restored data is used to run the service.

Deleting the game account does not delete your separate Unity Player Account, Apple account or Google account. Account management provides the separate Unity provider-account option. Deleting a provider account alone is not a substitute for deleting the game account.

For data disclosure or other privacy requests about your separate Unity Player Account, contact unity-player-login-privacy@unity3d.com. To delete that provider account, use https://player-account.unity.com/delete-account.

Support and your rights

If you email us, we receive your email address and the message and attachments you send. We use them to respond, investigate the issue and handle related privacy or purchase requests. Do not send passwords, sign-in tokens or payment-card details.

Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion or a copy of your personal data, object to certain uses, withdraw consent or complain to your data-protection authority. Contact bashtoash@gmail.com. We may ask for limited information to verify that the account is yours. Email support is available for questions; it is not required to start the in-app game-account deletion process.

Children, security and changes

Bash To Ash is intended for a general audience and is not designed for children under 13. A parent or guardian should review the app's online features and privacy choices with younger players. If you believe a child has provided information contrary to applicable age or consent requirements, contact us so we can investigate and address it.

Online connections use encryption, and access to account data is restricted to the services that need it. No system can guarantee absolute security. Providers may process information outside your country, including in the United States, using the safeguards described in their policies.

We update this policy when practices change. The app includes the effective date and will identify material changes. Contact Rawan Alghamdi at bashtoash@gmail.com with privacy questions.

These documents are also available inside the app, including when you are offline.
